description: This file defines an Android Activity class named BrokenKeyDerivationActivity, which demonstrates how to derive cryptographic keys insecurely and securely from a password, perform encryption and decryption of data, and handle related cryptographic operations. It includes mock functions to simulate file I/O for storing encrypted data and cryptographic parameters, and showcases the re-encryption process with warnings about insecure practices.

classes.name: BrokenKeyDerivationActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating insecure and secure key derivation, encryption/decryption practices, and handling of encrypted data within an Android application.

methods.name: deriveKeyInsecurely
methods.description: Derives an insecure AES key from a password emulating SHA1PRNG, using a custom key derivator.

methods.name: deriveKeySecurely
methods.description: Derives a secure AES key from a password using PBKDF2 with HMAC-SHA1.

methods.name: retrieveData
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted data, re-encrypts with a secure key if initially stored insecurely, and returns the decrypted string with relevant warnings.

methods.name: encryptOrDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption with CBC mode and PKCS padding.

methods.name: encryptData
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES CBC mode.

methods.name: decryptData
methods.description: Decrypts data using AES CBC mode.

methods.name: cleanRoomStart
methods.description: Initializes mock encrypted data and cleans up any previous files to ensure consistent test conditions.

methods.name: isDataStoredWithInsecureKey
methods.description: Checks whether the mock encrypted data is stored with an insecure key based on file existence.

methods.name: retrieveIv
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a random Initialization Vector (IV) for encryption.

methods.name: retrieveSalt
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a salt for key derivation.

methods.name: retrieveEncryptedData
methods.description: Returns the mock encrypted data bytes.

methods.name: storeDataEncryptedWithSecureKey
methods.description: Stores encrypted data indicating it has been re-encrypted with a secure key.

methods.name: readFromFileOrCreateRandom
methods.description: Reads bytes from a file or generates random bytes if the file does not exist, then saves them.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file with given name exists in the app's file directory.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file in the app's file directory.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes byte data to a specified file in the app's file directory.

methods.name: readBytesFromFile
methods.description: Reads bytes from a specified file in the app's file directory into a buffer.
